name: protein kinase C delta

function.text: PRKCD encodes protein kinase C delta type [Cleaved into: Protein kinase C delta type regulatory subunit; Protein kinase C delta type catalytic subunit]. Annotated molecular activities include protein kinase activity and calcium,diacylglycerol-dependent serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in signal transduction and intracellular signal transduction.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to systemic lupus erythematosus (autosomal recessive); autoimmune lymphoproliferative syndrome, type III caused by mutation in PRKCD (autosomal recessive).

somatic.text: Somatic sequence alterations have cohort-level candidate-driver evidence in Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma. This gene-level statistical evidence requires allele-specific review and does not establish the effect of every variant.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal recessive; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
